theorem.attribution: Published DAG adjustment criterion, used only for its sufficiency on the declared binary SCM subclass.

scientific_scope.model: Known static recursive SCM; explicit observed/latent partition; independent structural errors
scientific_scope.variables: At most eight binary nodes, an implementation replay budget
scientific_scope.target: Single observed treatment and outcome; full interventional distribution
scientific_scope.information: Full symbolic observed joint law, with reviewed strict positivity
scientific_scope.review: Separately declared review bound to the complete input; no reviewer authentication
scientific_scope.output: Symbolic observable functional; no estimated value

mapping.claim: Forbidden set plus proper back-door separation yields the adjustment functional; independent original-path checking is used for replay.
mapping.limitation: The Gaussian necessity construction is not imported as a binary necessity proof.

mapping.claim: Source adjustment criterion and sufficient observable adjustment identity.
For the current singleton-treatment setting, minimal adjustment and classical backdoor sets coincide, including restriction to available observed candidates.
mapping.limitation: Additional valid specified sets do not imply additional targets identifiable by unrestricted set search.
